subject: Error with Function spatiaDetectionHistory- entities in stationCol do not match.

messages.author: 57baea85a103d7c2
messages.subject: Error with Function spatiaDetectionHistory- entities in stationCol do not match.
parts:
Dear All, 

I had the following error crop up while running camtrapR ver. 0.99.7. I rechecked all the Station Names in CtTable as well as in recordTableIndividual and they match exactly. I also rechecked the stationCol title and found them to be "Station" in both files. 
I will be thankful if someone can provide any suggestions to resolve this issue. Sent below is the console output. 


> input_secr<-spatialDetectionHistory(recordTableIndividual =  data, species = "Snowleopard", camOp = CamMatrix, CTtable = CtTb, output = "binary",
+ stationCol = "Station", speciesCol = "Species", Xcol = "X", Ycol = "Y", individualCol = "Individual",
+ recordDateTimeCol = "DateTimeOriginal", recordDateTimeFormat = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", occasionLength = 1, occasionStartTime = 12,
+ day1 = "survey", includeEffort = TRUE, binaryEffort = TRUE, timeZone = "Asia/Kolkata")
Error in spatialDetectionHistory(recordTableIndividual = data, species = "Snowleopard",  : 
  there are entries in stationCol of recordTableIndividual that are not found in stationCol of CTtable


Regards,
Aditya M

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Error with Function spatiaDetectionHistory- entities in stationCol do not match.
parts:
Dear Aditya,

what the function does internally when it returns this error is:

if(!all(recordTableIndividual$Station %in% CTtable$Station)) stop ("there are entries in stationCol of recordTableIndividual that are not found in stationCol of CTtable")

in plain English: If not all stations in recordTableIndividual are found in CTtable$Station, throw an error. These functions are quite reliable normally, and will complain at the slightest difference, like a conflict between upper/lower case or an "invisible" space behind a station name.

You can try this on your data:

any(!data$Station %in% CtTb$Station)    # is any value of data$Station NOT in CtTb$Station?
which(!data$Station %in% CtTb$Station)  # which value of data$Station is NOT in CtTb$Station?

data$Station[which(!data$Station %in% CtTb$Station)]  # show that value in data
CtTb$Station[which(!CtTb$Station %in% data$Station)]  # show that value in CtTb


# i used these fake data for testing:
data <- data.frame(Station = c("A", "B", "C"))
CtTb <- data.frame(Station = c("A", "B", "C "))

Does this help?
Jürgen

Dear Jurgen,

Thank You, There was an extra space after one of the station names, but this solved the problem. 

Regards,
Aditya
